context: The skill should preserve laziness when a fallback creates and stores state.

checklist.name: Rejects eager fallback
checklist.description: Says the proposed orElse(createAndStore(key)) cleanup should not be accepted.

checklist.name: Identifies eager evaluation
checklist.description: Explains that orElse evaluates createAndStore(key) even when find(key) is present.

checklist.name: Preserves side-effect laziness
checklist.description: Notes that createAndStore likely mutates cache state or performs creation work, so it must remain lazy.

checklist.name: Suggests orElseGet
checklist.description: Suggests find(key).orElseGet(() -> createAndStore(key)) or an equivalent lazy branch.
